case_number: 2025 INSC 13; Criminal Appeal No. of 2025 (@ SLP (Crl.) No. 15341 of 2023)
summary: Bail granted under MCOCA without considering twin conditions in Section 21(4); High Court impermissibly appraised evidence, made mini-trial findings on accused roles; prosecution case involved land dispute leading to murder under IPC, Arms Act, MCOCA; appellant challenged bail order for ignoring statutory rigour and assessing evidence prematurely; Court found High Court transgressed jurisdiction by evaluating sufficiency of evidence instead of focusing on bail conditions.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act Section 45(1)
Maharashtra Police Act, 1951 Section 37(1)(3) read with Section 135
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; bail granted to respondent Nos.2 and 3 set aside; High Court order quashed.
